name: Lamb Of God
overview: The title 'Lamb of God' is a distinctive appellation of Jesus, emphasizing His unique role in bearing away the sin of the world, as declared by John the Baptist in John 1:29. This imagery is further developed in Revelation, where the Lamb is depicted as the central figure of divine authority and salvation, worthy of worship and able to provide eternal sustenance and comfort to His people (Revelation 6:16; 7:9-10, 14, 17). The Lamb’s sacrificial blood purifies believers, enabling them to stand before God clothed in righteousness and receive His eternal care.
